g.text: SWFW_5S_12 — System Flow
Monitor → Understand → Operate → Audit
Admin setup / login → Argon2id verification
HttpOnly session + CSRF; optional API Bearer boundary
Dashboard / inventory CRUD → SQLite
Validate syntax and duplicate address:port; NOT_CHECKED
Onboarding → scan presented SSH host key
Display fingerprint; independently verify before explicit trust
Persist known_hosts → strict SSH identity verification
Unknown / changed key rejected; no silent trust or key replacement
Scheduler / explicit check → bounded SSH child process
Concurrency + total deadline → timestamped observation in SQLite
Availability and freshness classification → dashboard
REACHABLE / UNREACHABLE / CHECK_ERROR / STALE / NOT_CHECKED
Understand: Prometheus samples → fixed-query health proxy
Native Fleet Health + Grafana; source times, gaps and units
Operate → four read-only actions → bounded execution
uptime / memory / disk / service status → result + durable audit
Error / degraded paths: validation, trust, auth, timeout, capacity, source unavailable
Safe errors + explicit uncertainty; no false zeros, fabricated health or automatic operation replay
